name: labs/janelia-python__zaber_device_python
title: Zaber stage (zaber_device.ZaberStage)
intro: Zaber stage (zaber_device.ZaberStage), adapted from janelia-python/zaber_device_python. It reads `x_position`, `y_position`, `z_position`, `x_actuator_id` and 3 more; sets `x_microstep_size`, `y_microstep_size`, `z_microstep_size`, `x_travel` and 2 more; runs `home`, `stop_motion`, `move_absolute`, `move_relative` and 2 more. `home`: home every device in the chain and report the home status of the configured axes. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
